messages:
aria: FYI HelioHealth POC reporting intermittent SSE stream truncation on Android during staging demos. They get JSON parse errors mid-stream. Demo scheduled tomorrow so this is urgent.

samir: Which SDK version and model/route?

aria: Android SDK v0.9.3, route POST /v1/stream/generate model=open-sim-13b. Client error: \"org.json.JSONException: Unterminated object at character 1023\".

priya: Can you paste server logs for the failing connection and any client stacktrace?

aria: server snippet pasted:
```
2026-03-18T14:22:11Z INF client=helio/staging conn=abcd1234 bytes_sent=6248
2026-03-18T14:22:24Z ERR stream_chunk_incomplete conn=abcd1234 last_event_len=14 expected_event_end=\"\\n\\n\"
2026-03-18T14:22:24Z WARN client_parse_error client=helio/staging err=\"partial chunk dropped\"
```

josh: That looks like we cut mid-event. Common culprits: CDN/app-gateway flushes, small MTU writes, or client closes. Any intermediaries?

aria: Customer topology: mobile -> NAT -> CloudFront-like CDN -> app gateway -> our edge. They tested direct-to-edge once; failures decreased but still non-zero.

samir: Short-term: client should buffer SSE frames until full event delimiter (\\n\\n) and use incremental UTF-8 decoding. Server-side quick win: append a sentinel event after logical chunks so clients receive complete JSON payloads.

samir: Android reader snippet I sent to customer:
```
StringBuilder buf = new StringBuilder();
String line;
while ((line = reader.readLine()) != null) {
  buf.append(line).append(\"\\n\");
  if (buf.toString().endsWith(\"\\n\\n\")) {
    String event = buf.toString().trim();
    // parse event.payload -> JSON
    buf.setLength(0);
  }
}
```

aria: Customer says they already buffer but still hit invalid UTF-8 sequences (multi-byte characters split across frames) which break their decoder.

josh: Right — split multibyte UTF-8 boundaries cause decoder errors. Two mitigations: 1) server adds a small sentinel event to provide safe framing; 2) client uses a CharsetDecoder with incremental decoding to handle split codepoints. Also bump route keepalive so proxies don't flush idle sockets.

priya: I'll open runtime ticket to add an optional per-route sentinel flag. Also file SDK ticket to harden Android streaming decoder.

ops-bot: Created INF-7243 (eng-runtime) priority=P1 owner=@samir labels=[streaming,poc,helio]

samir: I can hot-toggle a flag for the customer's routing key: send_fragment_sentinel=true which appends `event: fragment_end\\ndata: {\"last\":true}\\n\\n` after logical chunks. Low-risk.

aria: Customer approved immediate toggle for staging.

josh: Also recommend keepalive override to 15s on that route to reduce proxy flush races.

kendall-sales: Need ETA for stabilization before tomorrow's demo and whether dedicated capacity will help. Customer is asking pricing.

priya: Dedicated capacity reduces noisy-neighbor jitter but won't prevent CDN-induced fragmentation. We'll offer the sentinels + keepalive immediately and provide SDK guidance and a timeline for SDK/runtime fixes.

samir: Toggled send_fragment_sentinel for helio-staging at 2026-03-18T15:12Z. Monitoring logs now.

aria: Customer ran ~20 sessions after toggle: no parse exceptions on direct edge. CDN path failures dropped significantly (approx 1 in 300). They will rerun full demo path.

priya: Follow-ups logged: INF-7243 (eng-runtime sentinel + UI), INF-7244 (eng-sdk Android incremental UTF-8), INF-7245 (eng-platform route keepalive override).

kendall-sales: I'll update HelioHealth: low-risk server toggle applied, SDK guidance provided, timeline for fixes and dedicated pricing options. Thanks team :tada:

aria: Closing loop with the customer and scheduling post-demo retrospective. Marking resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
